user.title: Add HAm-rotator
user.description: By default this uses PstRotator's own UDP input (port 12000) - no changes needed inside PstRotator itself. Pick Hamlib rotctld or a custom command under Protocol if you'd rather use those.

data.name: Name
data.qth_locator: QTH locator (e.g. JO21QE) — sets the center of the map

error.invalid_qth_locator: Invalid QTH locator. Try something like JO21 or JO21QE.

abort.already_configured: This HAm-rotator instance is already configured.

data.custom_is_udp: Send custom command over UDP (off = TCP)
data.qth_locator: QTH locator (e.g. JO21QE) — takes priority over the coordinates below
data.home_latitude: Home latitude (optional, instead of a QTH locator)
data.home_longitude: Home longitude (optional, instead of a QTH locator)

storm.title: Storm position
storm.description: Set an azimuth the antenna automatically turns to once wind speed rises above the configured threshold. Leave the wind sensor field empty to disable this. If an averaged wind direction sensor is set, the antenna turns to track the wind instead of the fixed storm azimuth.

data.storm_azimuth: Storm position azimuth (degrees) — fallback if no wind direction sensor is set
data.wind_speed_threshold: Wind threshold (same unit as the sensor)
data.wind_direction_entity: Wind direction sensor (realtime, shown as an arrow on the card)
data.wind_direction_avg_entity: Wind direction sensor (10-minute average, used for storm turns)

antenna.title: Antenna beamwidth
antenna.description: Draws a transparent triangle on the map showing the antenna's beam. Enter the beamwidth (-3dB) directly, or enter the antenna gain to have the beamwidth calculated automatically (an approximation, not an exact figure for any specific antenna). Gain takes priority if both are set.

data.antenna_gain: Antenna gain (dBi) - calculates the beamwidth automatically

presets.title: Preset buttons
presets.description: Buttons do nothing when not filled in.
